physical_description.build: Lean and angular, with the wiry musculature of someone who stays active despite age. Shoulders held with practiced ease—the posture of someone used to command.
physical_description.hair_style: Short, professionally maintained undercut with subtle silver threading braided into the sides
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with fine network of gold capillaries—likely subdermal neural integration
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with amber undertones, showing the sun-weathered patina of decades in the GLMZ
physical_description.complexion: Lined face that maps decades of high-stakes negotiation. Laugh lines dominate; frown lines are minimal. Skin clear but textured. No cosmetic smoothing—she wears her age as currency.
distinguishing_marks: Faint scar running from left temple to cheekbone, approximately 7cm, slightly discolored but well-healed—old violence, professionally handled
Tattoo on inner right wrist: a stylized trading symbol in grey and gold ink, barely visible unless she extends her hand
Pale burn mark on left forearm, roughly the size of a cigarette end, repeated pattern suggesting deliberate cauterization—old nerve suppression work
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None immediately obvious. Possible subcutaneous neural integration suggested by eye capillary patterns. Hands show no chrome—all augmentations appear internal or minimalist.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical precision. Sits with spine straight, often with one hand visible and the other beneath the table. Eyes constantly cataloging exits, threats, opportunities. Speaks slowly—each word weighted. Rarely fidgets. When standing, she grounds herself with one foot forward, balanced for quick movement.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 practical elegance. Charcoal tactical shell jacket over a fitted cream or grey base layer, quality synthetic that breathes. Dark trousers with reinforced knees and discrete cargo pockets. Black boots—practical, expensive, broken in. Minimal jewelry: a thin platinum band on her left ring finger (widow's rings are currency in fixer circles) and a small chronometer wrist unit. Everything is designed for function and subtlety—nothing shouts wealth, but nothing screams poverty either. Her clothes are tools.
